name: Incompatible Realizable Gated Amalgam
properties: The union and both pieces are ample partial cubes. Each piece is gated in the union, is downward closed in its private coordinate, has an exact rational separation certificate of margin at least $1/240$, and has separator coefficient ratio zero. Their section-row cycle ratios are respectively $1/3$ and $3$, forcing disjoint extension spaces; hence the 33-word gated amalgam has separation margin zero and is not realizable ample. More exactly, opposite zero-entropy section circulations force its coefficient ratio to be one.
